svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Introduction to Kubernetes, slide 10 of 12: Rolling updates
svg.desc: Rolling updates: three v1 frontend pods (sha-0902b98) are replaced one at a time by v2 pods; a new pod must be ready before an old one stops, so traffic keeps flowing; kubectl set image starts the update and kubectl rollout undo deployment/frontend brings v1 back.
svg.text: New pods replace old ones one at a time, so visitors never notice the update.
a v2 is ready, then a v1 stops
Traffic never stops: the Service only sends visitors to pods that are ready.
The game's footer shows which commit is live, so you can watch it change.
